subject: Short request: timeboxed data exemption for troubleshooting - FinApps incident
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finapps.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Urgent: Can you extend retention for a short troubleshooting window?

Hi Sofia / Monica,

We started seeing increased error rates in our streaming inference calls around 08:30 UTC this morning. Our engineers need a short snapshot of request/response traces and the associated KV cache entries to reproduce the failure — the current tenant retention rolled logs out of our debug bucket 36 hours ago.

Request: can Redwood hold a scoped snapshot of the following for 72 hours:
- request IDs that match SUP-4721 (we've attached a 20-line log snippet)
- inference traces and signing headers for the finapps-prod tenant
- any runtime error stacks for the GPU workers serving finapps-prod

We understand retention policy constraints and residency requirements (FinApps is EU-hosted). We only need this for a short timebox to run a replay and patch. Please let us know what minimal approval or form you need; we can sign something if that helps (happy to redline a short DPA addendum).

Attachments: app-log-snippet.txt, incident-screenshot.png

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Platform Reliability
FinApps

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finapps.com>
Cc: michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2028 09:35:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Urgent: Can you extend retention for a short troubleshooting window?

Thanks for the detail, Alex — I saw the snippet and the spike on our dashboards. Monica is OOO this morning but I wanted to get the approval path started.

Internal notes / ask: Michael, Karthik — can security/compliance sign off on a 72-hour, scoped snapshot limited to the artifacts Alex listed? Key constraints: data must remain in EU region, access must be restricted to two named engineers (FinApps and Redwood), and audit logging must be enabled for any access. If we can get a signed form from FinApps acknowledging the scope, we can route to infra for the snapshot.

Alex — can you confirm the two engineer contacts from your side and whether the snapshot must be exported out of the EU (preferred: no)? Also, please provide the HubSpot incident id or any internal ticket reference you want on the exemption form.

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@finapps.com>, michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Urgent: Can you extend retention for a short troubleshooting window?

On Wed, Mar 1, 2028 at 09:12 AM Alex Turner <alex.turner@finapps.com> wrote:
> We started seeing increased error rates in our streaming inference calls around 08:30 UTC this morning...

Folks — Security has reviewed a similar ask before; we can approve a limited, timeboxed exemption provided we capture the following in the exemption form and infra enforces it: 
- Exact dataset keys and request ID filters (FinApps must list these)
- Duration: 72 hours from snapshot creation (no extension without new approval)
- Residency: data stored only in eu-central-1 (no export)
- Access list: up to 3 named FinApps engineers + 2 Redwood engineers (names required)
- Audit requirements: read-only access, full audit log retention for 90 days

I've attached a short "exemption-form.pdf" (fill the yellow fields). Once we have the signed PDF and the engineer names, I will route to infra to create an isolated snapshot and to SRE to enable the read-only audit role. We'll reference JIRA SUP-4721 so change history ties to the incident.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Compliance (on-call)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: exemption-form.pdf
Related: JIRA:SUP-4721, https://redwood.app/drive/incident-finapps-20280301

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finapps.com>, sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 15:27:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Urgent: Can you extend retention for a short troubleshooting window?

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround. We received the filled exemption form this morning and have completed internal approvals.

Summary of what we've approved: 
- Scope: request/response traces and selected KV cache entries for tenant finapps-prod (as listed on the form)
- Window: 72 hours starting 2028-03-03T16:00:00Z
- Residency: Data will remain in eu-central-1 and will not be exported off-region
- Access: FinApps engineers James Patel <james.patel@finapps.com> and Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@finapps.com>; Redwood engineers: michael_grant, karthik_iyer
- Audit: full access logs enabled; any downloads require a documented justification and additional sign-off

Infra will create the snapshot and SRE will enable a read-only role. Please coordinate directly with Michael (michael_grant@redwood.ai) for the replay steps.

Note: Security requires the signed exemption to be retained with the incident record for compliance audits. We will attach it to JIRA SUP-4721 and the drive folder.

Thanks — letting infra and FinApps run the replay.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Lead, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: incident-screenshot.png (for reference)
